extraction_notes: Supplementary tables S1-S8 are referenced but not included in the supplied text; only values visible in the main article text/figures were extracted. Pure support-only ZrO2/SiO2 reference runs in Fig. 2A were not extracted. The Fig. 5E stability plot is a dense time-on-stream trace with changing conditions and many unlabeled individual points; exact point-by-point conversions/selectivities were not extracted beyond exact values stated in the text.
